warnings: All callouts use ø and the notes sheet (S-01 ข้อ 2) specifies round bar SR-24 for all reinforcement, so every bar is RB with no conflict.
F3's mat prints two different counts, '6 ø9 มม.' and '8 ø9 มม.' — one per direction. Which count runs which way is not stated; recorded as count 14 with both printed, direction not asserted.
F1 and F2 are spread footings (no piles) for the แบบฐานแผ่ system; F3 is a 3-pile cap for the แบบตอกเข็ม system (S-01).

In every footing section, the 0.20|0.20 pair printed above the cap on each side of the column (from the column face outward) is not a pedestal or cap dimension derivable from the plans; left un-interpreted.
